headerDisplay:
## homebridge-script2
Configure Script2 in Homebridge UI without editing JSON manually.

name.title: Platform Name
name.description: Display name for this platform instance in Homebridge.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Define one or more Script2 accessories managed by this platform.

fileState.title: State File Path
fileState.description: If set, the on/off state is based on file existence and overrides state command.

state.title: State Command
state.description: Command that prints current state (for example: true/false).

on_value.title: ON Match Value
on_value.description: State command output value interpreted as ON.

polling.title: Enable Polling
polling.description: Poll state command periodically (ignored when State File Path is set).

state_cache_ttl_ms.title: State Cache TTL (ms)
state_cache_ttl_ms.description: Short cache for burst reads to avoid duplicate command execution.

unique_serial.title: Unique Serial
unique_serial.description: Recommended unique serial per device for HomeKit apps.
